Consider the portion of the surface z=x+y3 whose projection onto the xy-plane is bounded by y=x2 and y=1. Find a repeated integral expression for the surface area of this surface.

a
∫−11∫x212+4y2dydx
b
∫−11∫x211+ydydx
c
∫−11∫x212+3y2dydx
d
∫−11∫x212+9y4dydx
e
∫−11∫x211+3y4dydx
